source_to_cell_map.coordinate_definition: Every output row retains the original worksheet row and full source-row cell range.
source_to_cell_map.transformation: openpyxl read_only/data_only extraction; no abundance rescaling, protein remapping, non-detection inference or rank transformation.

permitted_use: Create a source-to-cell map and source-local rank transform after the R3 protocol amendment.
Use as an independent-laboratory external rank-only source with all source-specific caveats retained.
prohibited_use: Do not concatenate spectral counts or normalized abundances with any other study's raw quantitative scale.
Do not treat a missing table row as non-detection, and do not claim clinical or biological generalization from this single source.
